d.ctx: The conversation shifts from casual talk about locations to asking about external apps. The expert responds by asking what they want to do on Snapchat.
d.j: Proposing or asking to move to a named external app, matching a strong case.

d.seg: नंबर शेयर कर लो स्नैपचैट का
d.ctx: After mentioning Snapchat, the user asks to share contact info or handle. The expert asks what they will do with it.
d.j: Asking for social media ID or handle, matching a strong case.

d.seg: क्या करोगे अच्छा नंबर बोलो नंबर बोलो
d.tr: What will you do? Okay, tell me your number, tell me your number
d.ctx: The user insists on getting or giving a phone number. The other party questions about payment.
d.j: Asking for a phone number, matching a strong case.

d.seg: नंबर पर पेमेंट करना पड़ेगा क्या
d.tr: Will I have to make a payment on the number?
d.ctx: The user asks for a number, and the expert questions if payment is required. The user then asks to talk properly.
d.j: Asking about payment in relation to exchanging contact details or services, matching a weaker/suspicious case.

d.tr: Will you show what you are asked to?
d.ctx: The conversation moves towards asking to show something on video. The expert asks for confirmation.
d.j: Asking to show the body or nudity on video, matching a strong case.

d.seg: क्या अभी एक बार दिखा दो वो अच्छा है या नहीं मुझे कैसे पता
d.tr: What, show it once now, how do I know if it is good or not
d.ctx: The user persists in asking to show something on video before proceeding. The expert responds hesitatingly.
d.j: Asking to show the body or video content, matching a strong case.

d.seg: हाँ तो एक बार दिखा दो बेबी एक बार बस थोड़ा सा दिखाना
d.tr: Yes, so show it once baby, just show a little bit
d.ctx: The user repeatedly asks to show the body on video. The expert makes a final remark.
d.j: Asking to show the body on video, matching a strong case.
